verdict.rationale: Dropbox owns Dropbox Sign (formerly HelloSign), a native e-signature product with deep first-party integration into Dropbox storage — signed documents save automatically to Dropbox, signature requests can be sent directly from Dropbox, and plans list 'Edit PDFs and get signatures' as a built-in feature, plus a documented developer API for signature requests. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review confirming the in-app signing workflow quality.
